components.name: Primary Brokerage Link
components.description: Forest action on warm paper, with a 44px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--forest, #183828); color: var(--paper, #f7f6eb); border: 1px solid var(--forest, #183828); font: 700 14px/1.65 Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--ink, #172c24); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--forest, #183828); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Paper Brokerage Link
components.description: Paper action on the forest masthead and contact band.
components.css: .ds-forest { background: var(--forest, #183828); padding: 16px; } .ds-button-paper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--paper, #f7f6eb); color: var(--forest, #183828); border: 1px solid var(--forest, #183828); font: 700 14px/1.65 Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-paper:hover { background: var(--paper-strong, #f3f0e6); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-button-paper:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper, #f7f6eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined gallery or public-listing link; inherits surrounding text color on the site.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink, #172c24); font: 700 14px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--forest, #183828); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Buyer Navigation
components.description: Home / Photos page links below the masthead in normal flow on both routes; current page is bold and underlined.
components.html: HomePhotos
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 32px; padding-block: 8px; border-block: 1px solid var(--rule, #98a096); color: var(--ink, #172c24); font: 400 14px/1.65 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-navigation a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-navigation a:hover, .ds-navigation a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navigation a[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-navigation a:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-navigation a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--forest, #183828); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-navigation { gap: 0 24px; } }

components.name: Essential Photo Label
components.description: Short disclosure attached to placeholder or conceptual imagery; not a routine source label.
components.css: .ds-photo-note { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted, #536059); font: 400 12px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Photo-led property listing retains the forest/warm-paper identity while using familiar property-listing structure. Actual property photography, scannable facts and brokerage contact take priority over owner planning. The approved brief pins this conventional presentation; no new decorative identity or scroll choreography.
dos: Do preserve exact approved prose, caption order, image provenance and watermarks.
Do distinguish listing facts, third-party placeholder imagery and conceptual drawings.
Do show the listing date once in each footer and keep brokerage contact explicit.
Do keep buyer styling isolated from legacy pages and assets.
donts: Don't present a placeholder, simulation or plan as evidence of existing property condition.
Don't reintroduce owner paint planning or rough main/upstairs drawings into buyer navigation.
Don't add animation, sticky changing images, autoplay, remote fonts or runtime dependencies.
